comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Does this lower the minimum disguise level for Istanbul like Arabic does for Alexandria?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Yes, it does lower Istanbul's disguise requirement from 60, down to 50.

Source: unchartedwaters.wikia.com/wiki/Disguise

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: Yes it does. For example Istanbul requires 60 disguise level to enter, but if you, or an aide, has Turkish language it's lowered to 50. This also applies with Persian to the ports of Basra and Hormuz too.
